subject: Claude CCAF: Claude Code Configuration & Workflows
description: Glob-based rule files in .claude/rules/, path scoping frontmatter, and modular project guidelines.

questions.question: Terraform conventions should load only when editing .tf files, not for all files. How do you configure this?
options: Create a /terraform slash command that loads the conventions on demand.
Create a .claude/rules/ file with YAML frontmatter paths: ['terraform/**/*'] so the rules only activate when editing matching files.
Add Terraform conventions to the root CLAUDE.md under a # Terraform section header.
Create a CLAUDE.md file in the terraform/ directory.
questions.answer: Create a .claude/rules/ file with YAML frontmatter paths: ['terraform/**/*'] so the rules only activate when editing matching files.
questions.source: UD3-057 | Claude Code settings — rules and path scoping
questions.explanation: .claude/rules/*.md files with YAML frontmatter paths: ['glob_pattern'] activate conditionally when files matching the pattern are edited.
questions.examTrick: Conditionally loaded rules for file types/paths = .claude/rules/ with paths frontmatter globs.

questions.question: A project uses JavaScript (Prettier) and Rust (rustfmt). How should CLAUDE.md handle this dual-language setup?
options: Rely on the language-specific formatters and don't include formatting rules in CLAUDE.md.
Use .claude/rules/ with glob-based rules: one file with **/*.js,**/*.ts for Prettier rules, another with **/*.rs for rustfmt rules.
Create separate CLAUDE.md files in js/ and rust/ directories.
Include both conventions in the root CLAUDE.md with clear section headers.
questions.answer: Use .claude/rules/ with glob-based rules: one file with **/*.js,**/*.ts for Prettier rules, another with **/*.rs for rustfmt rules.
questions.source: UD2-024 | Claude Code settings — rules · Memory
questions.explanation: Glob-based rules in .claude/rules/ decouple conventions from directory structure, loading Prettier rules for JS/TS and rustfmt for Rust automatically.
questions.examTrick: Dual-language repos = .claude/rules/ with language-specific path globs.
